scenarios.name: search_10_percent_next
queries:
SELECT field_devices.id, field_devices.created_at AS sort_value, CAST(field_devices.created_at AS TEXT) AS cursor_value, 0 AS sort_value_null FROM "field_devices" WHERE (
		NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facility_aggregate_lifecycle WHERE kind='field_device' AND resource_id=field_devices.id)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facility_aggregate_lifecycle WHERE kind='sps_controller_system_type' AND resource_id=field_devices.sps_controller_system_type_id)
		AND NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1 FROM facility_aggregate_lifecycle lifecycle
			JOIN sps_controller_system_types system_type ON system_type.id=field_devices.sps_controller_system_type_id
			WHERE lifecycle.kind='sps_controller' AND lifecycle.resource_id=system_type.sps_controller_id
		)
		AND NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1 FROM facility_aggregate_lifecycle lifecycle
			JOIN sps_controller_system_types system_type ON system_type.id=field_devices.sps_controller_system_type_id
			JOIN sps_controllers controller ON controller.id=system_type.sps_controller_id
			WHERE lifecycle.kind='control_cabinet' AND lifecycle.resource_id=controller.control_cabinet_id
		)) AND field_devices.id IN (
		SELECT id FROM field_devices WHERE LOWER(bmk) LIKE '%selectivity_p10%'
		UNION ALL
		SELECT id FROM field_devices WHERE LOWER(description) LIKE '%selectivity_p10%'
	) AND ((0 > 0 OR (0 = 0 AND (field_devices.created_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:04.997+00' OR (field_devices.created_at = '2026-01-01 00:00:04.997+00' AND field_devices.id < '08000000-0000-4000-8000-0000004c3f89'))))) ORDER BY sort_value_null asc,sort_value desc,field_devices.id desc LIMIT 301

Plans.Filter: (((created_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:04.997+00'::timestamp with time zone) OR ((created_at = '2026-01-01 00:00:04.997+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (id < '08000000-0000-4000-8000-0000004c3f89'::uuid))) AND (NOT EXISTS(SubPlan 1)) AND (NOT EXISTS(SubPlan 2)))
